Not a git repo, which matches the environment info. Only the single test file was created, and it's the only `*AgentTest.java` found; the full suite passes cleanly.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringUtilsAgentTest.java` (27 test methods, JUnit 5, self-contained, no lambdas/diamond operator). It covers `StringUtils`' core method families — empty/blank checks, trim/strip, equals, indexOf/contains, substring/left/right/mid, split/join, replace variants, starts/endsWith, numeric/alpha checks, case conversion, reverse/repeat, padding, abbreviate/truncate (including `IllegalArgumentException` boundary cases), countMatches/difference, Levenshtein distance (including threshold and null-argument errors), normalizeSpace/deleteWhitespace, chomp/chop, defaultString family, remove/prepend/append, wrap/unwrap, ordinal index lookups, common prefix/index-of-difference, overlay/rotate, and compare. All 27 methods pass with `./_tools/test.sh`.
